ios.desc:
Geometer: Map Measurement at Your Fingertips

Discover the ultimate tool for measuring distances on maps with Geometer. Whether you're planning a hike, designing a landscape, or analyzing geographical data, Geometer offers unparalleled ease of use.

Distance Measurement: Effortlessly calculate the distance between multiple points with precise metrics.

Geometer transforms your device into a powerful mapping tool. Download now and experience precision mapping like never before!
